inverter.load_failed: Inverter details could not be loaded.

status.no_command: Helman has not commanded a mode yet.
status.match: The inverter's mode registers match it.
status.unknown: Whether the inverter's mode registers match can't be told right now.

inverter.no_change: No change planned for today or tomorrow.

exception.mismatch: The inverter's mode registers don't match Helman's last command.

q.why: Why is the inverter doing this?

why.candidate: candidate: its condition isn't met, so it isn't executed
why.execution_off: Off: the schedule is shown but not applied
why.no_runtime: No executor record for this slot
why.explain: The schedule is Helman's plan, the last command is what Helman wrote to the inverter, and the configuration is what the inverter's mode registers read now. Matching registers are a configuration check, not proof of what the inverter physically does.
why.registers: Mode registers of the last command
why.evidence_note: A difference shows what the registers read; it does not by itself tell why (a write that failed, a change made on the inverter, or a register read late).

agreement.mismatch_observed: Doesn't match the last command; the registers hold {mode}
agreement.unavailable: Unknown: some mode registers can't be read
agreement.not_bound: Unknown: not every mode register of the profile is found
agreement.no_profile: Not readable for a Custom inverter

next.explain: Planned actions from the schedule; a candidate runs only once its condition is met.
next.optimizer_note: The schedule does not record why an optimizer chose this action.

limits.none: No limits are readable for this inverter.
limits.scope_helman: Helman config, written after each mode
limits.scope_config: Helman config: discharge floor to charge ceiling
limits.explain: Settings as the inverter and Helman's config report them now; they are limits, not measured flows.
limits.evidence_note: Inverter settings only; the battery's own BMS limits are not part of this answer.

operating.derived_note: The inverter derives its AC figures rather than measuring them separately, so conversion loss isn't visible here.
operating.temperature_summary: Today {min} to {max}, mean {mean}; warmest around {max_at}. {coverage} of the day so far is recorded.
operating.history_failed: Today's history could not be loaded.
operating.extrema_statistics: Five-minute averages; minimum and maximum are the recorder's five-minute statistics.
operating.extrema_recorded: Five-minute averages of recorded states; minimum and maximum are the raw recorded values.
operating.no_phases: No per-phase readings for this inverter.

trust.explain: How the integration's link to the inverter reports itself. This is the data available, not a full health check of the inverter.

grid.load_failed: Grid details could not be loaded.
grid.history_failed: Today's history could not be loaded.

status.idle: Hardly any grid flow right now ({power}).

q.phases: How is each phase using the grid?
q.money: What has the grid cost or earned today?
q.outage: What happens when the grid is unavailable?

voltage.no_profile: Needs a hardware profile with phase readings.
voltage.no_profile_long: Per-phase voltage needs a hardware profile on the inverter; this one is Custom, so there is nothing per phase to show.
voltage.no_sensors: The hardware profile's phase voltage sensors are not found or are disabled.
voltage.unavailable_now: Phase voltages are unavailable right now.
voltage.none_today: No phase voltage is recorded today yet.
voltage.spread: Largest difference between phases at one time
voltage.spread_none: Not enough simultaneous readings to compare phases.
voltage.explain: Today so far, in 5-minute steps, at the inverter's terminals. The shaded 207–253 V band and the 230 V line are references for orientation, not a compliance verdict or the inverter's protection setting.
voltage.source_statistics: Read from 5-minute statistics: each step's min and max are that step's own extremes.
voltage.source_history: Read from recorded states: min and max are recorded values, each held until the next.
voltage.weighting: The average weights each reading by how long it held, and a stretch without readings is a gap, never a zero. The difference between phases compares their 5-minute averages only where every compared phase has a reading.
voltage.location_note: These are the inverter's terminal voltages, not readings at the meter or the distribution grid's connection point; they can differ from the voltage there.
voltage.references_note: 230 V is the nominal low-voltage supply; 207–253 V is 230 V ±10 %. Supply standards such as EN 50160 judge 10-minute averages over a week, and the inverter's own over-voltage trip setting is not read here, so this chart cannot say whether either was met.

phases.no_profile: Needs a hardware profile with phase readings.
phases.no_profile_long: Per-phase power needs a hardware profile on the inverter; this one is Custom, so there is nothing per phase to show.
phases.unavailable: Phase readings are unavailable right now.
phases.explain: Power per phase at the grid meter. The current is estimated from power and voltage; it is not a measured current or breaker headroom.
phases.sign_note: Power is shown with import positive.
phases.calculation: Estimated current = |phase power| ÷ phase voltage, assuming a power factor of 1. Reactive power or a lower power factor make the real current higher.
phases.limitations: Power is the grid meter's, voltage the inverter's terminals'. The limit is the inverter's main-breaker setting, not the breaker's rating, so the comparison does not measure breaker headroom; phase sums or export power say nothing about it either.

money.failed: Today's money could not be loaded.
money.unpriced: No price recorded for today's grid flow.
money.unpriced_long: No import or export rate is recorded for today's grid flow, so nothing can be valued.
money.explain: Paid to and received from the grid: the import and export meters at each hour's rate. Energy without a rate is left out, not counted as zero, and fixed fees are not included.
money.valuation: The chart prices each slot from the price rails, while the totals above price each hour from recorded statistics, so the two can differ slightly.

next.explain: Planned figures are Helman's grid forecast, an estimate rather than a commitment.
next.explain_adjusted: Planned figures are Helman's grid forecast with the schedule applied, an estimate rather than a commitment.
next.evidence_note: Planned and measured grid flow with the price rails and the schedule; pick tomorrow in the day bar.

outage.explain: The state is the inverter's own run mode. Runtimes are its lifetime counters. Whether the backup output supplies the house during an outage depends on wiring and backup settings not read here.
outage.no_readings: No frequency or run mode reading is available.
outage.evidence_note: Readings as the inverter reports them now.

unavailable.no_house_node: Device reports need the house power sensor (Energy nodes → House → Power). Without it there is no house device tree to report on.
unavailable.no_house_meter: Device reports need the house energy meter (Energy nodes → House → Forecast → Total energy). Without it the house total and every remainder are unknown.

device_reports.missing_meters: Not configured: {meters}. The source colours cannot show what these meters would have measured.

quality.mismatch: {kwh} kWh ({pct} % of the house) of measured flows exceeding the house meter

daily_profile.title: Daily profile
daily_profile.per_day: Per day, over the hours with data
